about.text: I build backend systems, ML/LLM pipelines, and automation tools. My work spans distributed systems (a DHT routing library at IIT Kanpur), RAG chatbots with streaming, portfolio optimization with multi-agent debate, and LLM benchmarking research. Looking for a software engineering role at a startup where shipping fast and learning faster is the default.

experience.organization: Institute of Innovation & Entrepreneurship (IIE), BML Munjal University
bullets: Automated event-driven content publishing workflows in n8n, cutting turnaround time ~30%.
Gathered requirements; built prototypes: websites, portfolios, chatbots, automation tools.
Improved SEO via keyword targeting, meta tags, internal linking, sitemap, and page-speed work.
Built low-latency routing libraries for a scalable hybrid Chord-Tapestry DHT P2P network.
Cut average network latency ~25% through iterative optimization and edge-case testing.
Designed modular Dart components for routing abstraction and diagnostics, adopted by internal teams.

projects.name: Tangent
projects.desc: Multi-asset portfolio optimizer + multi-agent decision engine. FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Groq/LLaMA 3.3. 70+ asset universe, 5K+ Monte Carlo paths with Indian LTCG tax/inflation, 5-persona AI debate arena with Critic agent.

projects.name: DevPrompt
projects.desc: Structured-prompting benchmarking research for LLMs. 6-phase pipeline, 432 API calls; structured JSON improved Tool F1 ~15.3% (p=0.0016).

projects.name: MultiModal RAG Chatbot
projects.desc: RAG over 6 input types (text, URL, PDF, DOCX, image/OCR, YouTube). Node.js, ChromaDB, Ollama, Groq, SSE streaming — same technique this site uses.
